metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from kodak_vision3_200t (dyes and structure): Fujifilm Motion Picture Film Manual (Ref. KB-0707E) curves; spectral sensitivity borrowed from Eterna Vivid 160 (KB-0701E) Characteristic curves and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet (Status M curves on the ISO 250 speed point, unmixed with the base dyes; wedge spectrogram to illuminant E read as 1 log units per division); minimum density from the datasheet; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
